fact: A public-private partnership for the DRCPass national digital ID was signed in June 2025 with Trident Digital Tech, with investment need (CAPEX) of 97.1 million USD per the Plan ministry; the text says it is not stated whether the company must raise all the financing.
title: Identification numérique : 97,1 millions $ d’investissements pour déployer le DRCPass
